user_story: As a user, I want my password reset token to be invalidated after use so that it cannot be reused.

positive.title: Verify token invalidation after successful password reset
steps: Use the token to reset the password
Attempt to reuse the same token to reset the password again
positive.expected_result: The second attempt to use the token should fail with an error indicating the token is invalid.

negative.title: Verify system behavior when using an expired token
steps: Wait for the token to expire (if applicable)
Attempt to use the expired token to reset the password
negative.expected_result: The attempt to use the expired token should fail with an error indicating the token is invalid.

edge.title: Verify token invalidation for simultaneous requests
steps: Simultaneously attempt to reset the password using the token from two different locations
edge.expected_result: Only one password reset should be successful, the second attempt should fail with an error indicating the token is invalid.
